Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim purposes. Can you confirm
you're okay to continue?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Please describe in your own words what happened at the intersection.
A: I was making a left turn at a signal in Houston. The light had turned yellow and I was already in the intersection
when the other veihcle came through from the opposite direction and struck the front passenger side of my car.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Not really. I looked, but I was focused on getting through the turn. I think it was moving fairly quickly.
Q: Where were you coming from and where were you headed?
A: I was heading home from a job site. I was going to turn onto the side street on the left.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: Did anyone else ride in your vehicle?
A: No, I was alone.
Q: Have you been seen by a medical provider since the accident?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the same evening. They said I had a back strain. My lower back is sore and
stiff, especially when I bend or sit for a long time.
Q: Are you currently taking any medication or receiving treatment for that?
A: I'm taking an over-the-counter anti-inflammatory and I have a follow-up appointment scheduled with my primary
doctor next week.
Q: Is there anything you would like to add or correct about your account?
A: No, I think that covers it. I'll send over the clinic paperwork when I get it.
Q: Thank you. We'll follow up once we review the documents. This concludes the statement.
A: Thanks.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
